info.name: Salem_BackEnd APIs
info.description: Postman collection for Authentication, Department, Incidence, Notification, and Home endpoints.

request.description: Create Department using form-data (Name + Logo file). Requires Employee access token.
Get all departments.
Update Department name and/or logo using form-data. Requires Employee access token.
Delete department by id. Requires Employee access token.
Get all employees with Name, Email, Role, and Account_Status (نشط/معطل). Requires Employee access token.
Update employee data by id. Requires Employee access token.
Delete employee by id. Requires Employee access token.
Get all incidences.
Get incidences with optional filters: Department, Date (YYYY-MM-DD), Status, and Search by id.
Get all incidences with status New.
Get all incidences with status Assigned.
Get all incidences with status Review.
Get all incidences with status In_Progress.
Get all incidences with status Forworded.
Get all incidences with status Completed/Finished.
Get status, Lat, Long, and Location_Name for a single incidence by id.
Get full incidence details for a single incidence by id.
Create incidence by citizin using form-data. Requires Citizin access token.
Get all incidences created by the logged-in citizin. Requires Citizin access token.

item.name: Get My Citizin Incidence By ID

request.description: Get one incidence by id for the logged-in citizin only. Returns 404 if incidence does not belong to this citizin.
Assign incidence to the logged-in employee from token. Requires Employee access token.
Move any incidence status to Completed (Finished). Requires Employee token with role admin or supervisior.
Send notifications to operators in the same employee department and region for a given incidence. Requires Employee access token.

item.name: Move Incidence To In_Progress (POST Status Only)

request.description: Move incidence status from Assigned to In_Progress using employee token and incidence id in URL. No body required.

item.name: Move Incidence To In_Progress (PATCH + Update Location)

request.description: Update Lat/Long/Location_Name and move incidence from Assigned to In_Progress using employee token and incidence id in URL.
Upload Image_After_Analysis and What_Was_Done, then move incidence from In_Progress to Review.
Get Home dashboard summary for logged-in employee. Requires Employee access token.
Get monthly overview for incidences: total, assigned+in progress, in review, forwarded, and completed in this month.
Get incidence density points for heatmap (count per location coordinates).
Search incidences by Location_Name and return incidents details, solve times, average solve time, total incidences, and the most frequent department on this street.

item.name: Get Incidences Status Summary By Date

request.description: Get incidences counts by status in a custom date range (Completed, Review, Forworded, Total, and Assigned+In_Progress).

item.name: Get Department Incidences Summary By Date

request.description: Get total incidences and incidences count per department in a custom date range.

item.name: Get Incidences Time Counts By Date

request.description: Get incidences counts grouped by day, week, and month in a custom date range.
Get weekly chart data for incidences created during the current week.

item.name: Get Monthly Department Incidences Chart Data

request.description: Get monthly chart data: total incidences this month and count per department.
Get the latest incidence for each department.
Get all incidences with status New in the logged-in employee department.

item.name: Get Employee Completed And Current Incidences

request.description: Get completed and current incidences assigned to the logged-in employee.
Signup API for employee user.
Signup API for citizin user.
Login for employee using National_id and Password.
Single login API for citizin using Email_or_Phone_Number and Password.
Send OTP to email for password reset.
Verify OTP sent to email.
Reset password after OTP verification.
